build_standard_multihead_attention: build a StandardMultiheadAttention module with configurable num_heads, sdpa, and optional GQA support for transformer models
create_full_attention_state: create a FullAttentionState to accumulate projected keys and values during incremental decoding with capacity management
create_local_attention_state: create a LocalAttentionState with a sliding window for attention to limit KV cache during incremental decoding
register_attn_weight_hook: register an AttentionWeightHook on a MultiheadAttention module to capture computed attention weights after each forward pass
init_qkv_projection: init a Linear layer as a multi-head attention QKV projection using scaled Xavier uniform weight initialization
